title: 第七章 淬体
content_zh:
任天一双眼微眯，四十五度抬头目光望向窗外的夜空，缓缓道：

    “先提升你我的实力，只有我们有足够的的实力，才可以执子之手，共享逍遥人生。”

    白婧双眸含雾，心中满满的全是感动，从小到大受尽白眼，由于自己丑陋的容貌，备受嫌弃，甚至自己的母亲因生了自己也被父亲冷落，最终抑郁而终；长大后发现自己身患绝症，不能习武，更被周围人嫌弃和孤立，孤独自卑无时不刻都萦绕着自己，而眼前的少年让她看到了生活的希望。

    “六郎，谢谢你！”

    白婧说着，踮起脚尖在任天一的脸上留下了一吻，蜻蜓点水似的一吻后，她更是将发烫的脸颊藏在了任天一的怀里。

    任天一心中一动，正想趁机再好好体验一下，却发现白婧挣脱了任天一的怀抱，转身离开了。

    白婧过去打开了那个箱子。

    箱子里边放的是放的是一个个的丹药瓶。

    “提升实力，离不开资源，这是我出嫁时的陪嫁，不过是一些药液和丹药，原本以为这些药材用不上，六郎若有用尽管拿去用就是。”

    任天一随手打开了几瓶，不由暗自皱眉，这些丹药的药性很差，在他眼中简直就是一堆废丹。

    随即说道：“这几瓶淬体丹药虽然成色差了不少，不过还可以用用，其余这些丹药品阶太低，药性流逝严重，对你我的体质来说用处不大，若是能炼丹就好了。”

    “家族中的炼丹阁应该可以，只不过那些丹师定然不会帮助我们的。”白婧略显失望的说道。

    任天一用手刮了一下白婧的鼻梁，笑着说道：“婧儿多虑了，丹药的事就交给我吧，你的任务就是用心法提升修为，这篇心法只是入门，等你达到练气境，就可以修炼武技了。”

    虽然任天一尚未开脉，没有开辟出命宫，无法使用神魂之力来炼丹，但他认为凭借经验萃取药液或许是可以的。

    看着任天一一副胸有成竹的样子，白婧并不知道他这自信是来自于何处，很不放心的说道：“如今六郎是不傻了，但修为尚在炼体境，人心险恶，六郎在外还是小心为好。”

    “婧儿放心，你也看到了，任天行练气境三重也奈何不了我，一般人还伤不了我。”
content_en:
Ren Tian narrowed his eyes slightly, raised his head forty-five degrees and looked at the night sky outside the window, and said slowly:

    "Improve your and my strength first. Only when we have enough strength can we hold hands and share a happy life."

    Bai Jing's eyes were filled with mist, and her heart was filled with emotion. She had been looked down upon since she was a child, and was disliked because of her ugly appearance. Even her mother was ignored by her father after giving birth to her, and she eventually died of depression. When she grew up, she found that she was terminally ill, unable to practice martial arts, and was despised and isolated by the people around her. Loneliness and low self-esteem haunted her all the time, and the boy in front of her gave her hope in life.

    "Mukuro, thank you!"

    Bai Jing said, standing on tiptoes and leaving a kiss on Ren Tianyi's face. After a kiss like a dragonfly, she hid her hot cheek in Ren Tianyi's arms.

    Ren Tianyi's heart moved, and he was about to take the opportunity to experience it again, but found that Bai Jing broke away from Ren Tianyi's arms and turned around to leave.

    Bai Jing went over and opened the box.

    Inside the box are bottles of elixirs.

    "To improve your strength, you cannot do without resources. This is my dowry when I get married. It is just some medicinal liquids and elixirs. I originally thought that these medicinal materials would not be used. If Rokuro is useful, just use them."

    Ren Tianyi casually opened a few bottles and couldn't help but frown secretly. The properties of these elixirs were very poor. In his eyes, they were just a bunch of useless elixirs.

    Then he said: "Although the quality of these bottles of body tempering elixirs is quite different, they can still be used. The rest of these elixirs are of too low a level and their medicinal properties have been seriously lost. They are of little use to your and my physique. It would be great if we could make elixirs."

    "The alchemy pavilion in the family should be able to do it, but those alchemists will definitely not help us." Bai Jing said slightly disappointed.

    Ren Tianyi scraped the bridge of Bai Jing's nose with his hand and said with a smile: "Jing'er is worrying too much. Leave the elixir to me. Your task is to use mental methods to improve your cultivation. This mental method is just an introduction. When you reach the Qi training state, you can practice martial arts."

    Although Ren Tianyi has not yet opened his veins, opened up the Life Palace, and cannot use the power of the soul to refine elixirs, he believes that it may be possible to extract the medicinal liquid based on experience.

    Seeing Ren Tianyi's confident look, Bai Jing didn't know where his confidence came from, and said uneasily: "Liu Lang is no longer stupid now, but his cultivation is still in the body-refining realm, and people's hearts are sinister. Liu Lang should be careful outside."

    "Don't worry, Jing'er. You've also seen that even Ren Tianxing, who is at the third level of the Qi Training Realm, can't do anything to me. Ordinary people can't hurt me."
